name: gorgias-support-tickets-per-order
description: Use for "how many support tickets per order do we get", "why is our Gorgias volume up", "what are customers contacting us about", "how much of our support is where-is-my-order", "is our contact rate getting better", "which channel brings the most Gorgias tickets", or "what should we fix to cut support tickets for our store" — even when the user never says "contact rate". Use when the decision is which cause of support volume to fix first. Needs Gorgias and the store's Shopify orders.
